note: The allowed side of the delivery-coverage guard: every obligation formation emits is either written or explicitly withdrawn, so the guard reports nothing (each old test's unharmed check_delivery_coverage call passes). The guard skips coordinates the ledger withholds, so every claim checked here keeps its variant's states available (each of people's value, omit and untyped keeps a panel key when one is declared; probed). Literals: VALUE's states are the old gap test's claimed list [2019, 2021]; the rangeless pooled and unknown editions write nothing (old [pooled]/[unknown]: only 2019 claimed beside them; the old range-less label '2021-2022' now carries a range (Y-202), so the build equivalent is 'HT 2021 - VT 2022'); 2021 keeps its own length 2 (copied-length test: claims ('value','1') and ('value','2')); OMIT keeps only 2019 with one curated_state_omission (omission test: states and coverage [2019], diagnostics [curated_state_omission]); UNTYPED keeps its 2020 state with unknown_data_type (unrelated-diagnostic test: diagnostics [unknown_data_type], coverage 2020); PAR keeps only its safe variant's PAR_A and reports the parallel pair's unresolved representation on both 2020 rows (parallel test: states [people-3 VALUE]; causes' refs {first, second}, window 2020-01-01..2020-12-31). CVIDs come from the fixture.
fails_if: `form_native_variable` (source_formation.py) claims one coverage interval over VALUE's 2019..2021 hull or claims the pooled or unknown occurrence (CVIDs 1022, 1023), or writes one data_length across both VALUE windows, so the build reports unexplained_delivery_coverage_loss or unexplained_delivery_fact_change for scb/sample/value; or the [[coding.omit]] slice is no longer taken back from OMIT's obligation (unexplained loss for 2020); or a state with an unknown data type is dropped (UNTYPED's 2020 state disappears); or a variant's unresolved parallel columns withhold the whole variable (PAR's others/PAR_A state disappears)
